nodes.label: Device fingerprint v1 = phone + User-Agent only
nodes.rationale: Decisión fijada en spec §7 de docs/chatbot.md. No re-litigar. V1 = phone + User-Agent only.
nodes.norm_label: device fingerprint v1 = phone + user-agent only

nodes.label: Multitenant: data isolation by Tenant ID
nodes.rationale: Data isolation by Tenant ID is mandatory at the DB level; every query must be tenant-scoped. A user may belong to multiple tenants.
nodes.norm_label: multitenant: data isolation by tenant id

nodes.label: RBAC is dynamic
nodes.rationale: Roles and permissions are data created from the backend, not code. Never hardcode role enums or permission checks against fixed role names; frontend menus/buttons are driven by the role's permission list.

nodes.label: LLM abstraction layer
nodes.rationale: Business logic must never call a provider SDK (OpenAI/Gemini/Claude) directly — go through the provider-agnostic layer. Temperature, max tokens, system prompt, and provider are configurable per tenant or per endpoint.

nodes.label: Channel decoupling via broker
nodes.rationale: The core orchestrator must not depend on WhatsApp specifics. All channel I/O flows through the broker (RabbitMQ, persistent queues).

nodes.label: Invgate dedicated technical API user
nodes.rationale: Ticket create/read/update goes through a dedicated technical API user, not end-user credentials.

nodes.label: Secrets via env vars or vault
nodes.rationale: LLM and Invgate API keys only via env vars / vault — never committed.
nodes.norm_label: secrets via env vars or vault

nodes.label: Initial data model tables
nodes.rationale: Users, Tenants, Roles, Permissions, Devices, Conversations, Tickets, Metrics. Locked decision from spec §7.

nodes.label: LLM Externo multi-proveedor
nodes.rationale: Multi-proveedor: OpenAI, Google Gemini, Claude, etc. Parámetros como Temperature, Max Tokens, System Prompt y proveedor son configurables por tenant o endpoint.

nodes.label: Prisma 5.22.0
nodes.rationale: ORM estable, type-safe, soporte NestJS nativo.
